notes.title: Custom Achievements
notes.notes:
Hey All

It seems we are running out of space for custom achievements in Survival Zombies game and thats actually great, seems that the community likes the idea!

I am still processing requests now and this is just to give you heads up on this, as I see that I am running out of space soon. 

To address that I decided we will not add more achievements to Survival Zombies and fill just the empty spots left with custom achievements.

This is because lately I was adding more and more achievements to accommodate the demand,  however many people get irritated when this is done and I believe their wrath is reasonable, as they have to complete the game again and again and this has to stop at some point. 

As soon as all the empty places for custom achievements are filled, I will close the thread and will stop processing requests for this game. 

However, If you would like to get custom achievement anyway do not be worried!

I suggest you check other games from ANPA.US which have plenty of space left:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/575950/?snr=1_5_9__205

Also I will keep offering this a bonus feature to owners of the new games I will release. 

Dont forget to check out Red Wake Carnage which is coming out soon!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/656610/?snr=1_5_9__205

Thank you for your involvement in this idea!

ANPA.US

notes.title: Custom and Personalized Avatars
notes.notes:
Hey All:

While talking to one of the players of the Dinosaur Hunt game, he came up with a request, if it would be possible to have a custom avatar with his artwork and it seems it has worked fine for him. 

I would like to offer this feature to other players also, so If you would be interested in having your custom avatar available in Survival Zombies, 
just put your desired artwork in the comments (or just add me on Steam and tell me what you'd like, which would be quicker).

[b]The artwork needs to be created by you, it cant be avatar from other games or something created by someone else and used without permission.[/b]

I run all images through image google search, so no wallpapers and stuff that is copyrighted by some other party is allowed.

I hope you will find this satisfying.

Thank you for your support 

ANPA.US

notes.title: MULTIPLAYER GUIDE
notes.notes:
Hey! 

Here are some simple steps you need to follow to create a game (if there are no servers available): 

1. Create a server by clicking host a game
2. Choose a map
3. When a map loads, type in: your name and a server name you want people to see
4. Click join or host server

This will create a MP game, that others will see under Server Browser in the main menu

IF under the Server Browser there is a game available that you would like to join, just select it and it will load. 

Hope this Helps and would be great to have you feedback on this

Thanks

ANPAUS

- Building mode fixes

Thank you for playing and Enjoy

notes.title: Update May 14th - New Game Modes & Locations
notes.notes:
[h1] New Game Modes: [/h1]

- [b] Time Motion Mode [/b] - time depends on your velocity, if you move it runs smooth, but if you do not move it slows down

- [b] Moon Base mode [/b] - gravity is set to -0.1F so you can experience flying bodies and stuff

- [b] Time boxed mode [/b] - 60 seconds waves, if you kill all in 60 secs you win, if you don't you lose

- [b] Flood mode [/b]  - endless waves up to 100 enemies 

Classic modes:

- Campaign - Story based mode

- Survival - 4 waves challenge

[h1] 4 New Locations [/h1]

[h1] Bug fixes and UI updates [/h1]
